FreeMotion · build v16.90 · reviewed 24-25 Sep 2026

FreeMotion UX Review 00:00:00

Review bots used the app the way a person would, mostly on a 390px phone, plus a 1440px desktop and five other screen sizes, and one counted the taps for four everyday jobs. They wrote down everything that felt janky, confusing or slower than it should be. Nobody read the code, and every suggested fix keeps the feature it touches. Claude re-checked the biggest claims by hand and corrected the ones that were wrong.
